verified: The Financial Times reported, citing documents it reviewed, that Anthropic's internal data-centre programme is called Anthropic Direct and involves commitments of more than $900 billion through 2045, including a lease of 875,000 TPUs at $7.2 billion a year; the FT piece also describes a 600,000 sq ft Louisiana data centre with roughly 1,300 workers finishing construction.
unconfirmed: Anthropic has not publicly confirmed the Anthropic Direct name, the $900B+ total, the 875K TPU count or the $7.2B annual figure, and the underlying documents are not public, so the TPU supplier, contract terms and payment schedule are unknown; the $900B+ figure also differs from the $807 billion Anthropic's October IPO filing said it planned to spend on AI infrastructure, and the sources do not reconcile the two numbers.

verified: 据《金融时报》11 月 17 日报道（Techmeme 转述），Anthropic 一项名为“Anthropic Direct”的数据中心网络计划涉及到 2045 年逾 9000 亿美元的总承诺，相关文件显示其将以每年 72 亿美元租用 87.5 万块 TPU；报道同时描述了路易斯安那州一座 60 万平方英尺、约 1300 名工人施工的数据中心。此前《纽约时报》10 月 26 日援引 Anthropic 的 S-1 文件报道，公司计划在 AI 基础设施上投入 8070 亿美元，上半年营收 163 亿美元；Entrepreneur 10 月 28 日亦报道其招股书中的基础设施承诺延伸至 2045 年。
unconfirmed: Anthropic 未公开确认“Anthropic Direct”这一名称及租用规模、单价等条款，72 亿美元/年与 87.5 万块 TPU 均仅见于 FT 所引文件，无第二家独立媒体核实；TPU 的具体代际、供应商分工、数据中心选址与上线时间、融资方式均未披露；FT 的 9000 亿美元以上与 S-1 中的 8070 亿美元两个数字口径不同，现有来源未作解释，两者是否重叠无法确认。

titles.en: Report: Anthropic's "Anthropic Direct" plan commits $900B+ to 2045, leasing 875K TPUs
titles.zh: Anthropic Direct 被曝：9000 亿美元、87.5 万块 TPU
